meta.source: DESIGN.md «ليل» v1 + Design System sheet (Design_System_-____.dc.html) + bundled sheet fonts + app screenshots

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background (home, journal, calendar, settings). Light: the middle stop of the 135° gradient `bg-grad-1 → bg-grad-2 → bg-grad-3`; paint the gradient where the surface allows.

tokens.name: ground-deep
tokens.usage: Onboarding and reflection (استشعار) background — the only grounds that carry the star lattice.

tokens.name: ground-deepest
tokens.usage: Reflection step «التعمّق» (deepen) only.

tokens.name: glass-card
tokens.usage: Default card. Dark = white 6% over `ground` + backdrop blur 20; light = white 72% + blur 24. Radius `radius-card`, 1px `hairline`, `shadow-card`.

tokens.name: glass-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, tab bar, toast, filled chip. Blur 24, `shadow-raised`. Light theme has no separate raised value in the source — same glass as cards.

tokens.name: glass-inset
tokens.usage: Quran block, search field, setting rows, prompt card. No shadow.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px borders, dividers, ThreadProgress track, disabled button fill, toggle-off track. Light value is the source's white-90% glass edge — it reads against the gradient, not on white glass.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Titles and primary text on every ground and glass. Dark 15.4:1 on `ground`, 13.9:1 on `glass-card`; light (ink) 13.1–15.0:1 across the gradient.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on grounds and glass. Dark 10.5 / 9.5:1; light 8.4–9.6:1.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, timestamps, placeholders, attributions on grounds and glass. Dark 8.3 / 7.5:1 (kept as measured). Light lifted from the reference #6B7A90 (3.6–4.1 ✗) to 4.9–5.7:1.

tokens.name: gold-bright
tokens.usage: The only highlighted text colour: ayah text, active tab, small gold labels, gold text button, wordmark thread + dot. Dark 10.5 / 9.5:1. Light: gold-ink, 5.0–5.7:1.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Chip outlines, calendar «done» dots, ThreadProgress fill, scholar attribution, «ح» avatar ring. 7.9:1 on `ground`. نهار: terracotta #B9573B is 4.0:1 on cream — marks and outlines only; the 12px scholar attribution misses 4.5:1 there.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Fills only — primary button, today ring, toggle-on, prompt numbers. Never running text. White label on it 4.3:1 → labels ≥18px / 600 (large text). Light theme: gold-ink replaces violet (white on it 6.0:1).

tokens.name: violet-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed state. White on it 5.3:1. The light theme defines no pressed tint — same as `violet`.

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Label and knob colour on `violet` / `violet-pressed` fills.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete actions only. Dark 6.1:1 on glass; light 5.9:1. Always paired with a word (حذف), never colour alone.

tokens.name: ayah
tokens.usage: Quran text inside ﴿ ﴾ — gold on dark, ink on light. Set only in `ayah` type style.

tokens.name: quran-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of the Quran block and share-card ayah card.

tokens.name: chip-selected
tokens.usage: Selected chip fill (gold 18%) under `gold-bright` text. Light value derived from gold-ink at the same 18% — the source shows only dark.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backing behind a chip that sits on the star lattice (onboarding step label).

tokens.name: bg-grad-1
tokens.usage: `light` theme only: gradient start (135°).

tokens.name: bg-grad-2
tokens.usage: `light` theme only: gradient middle.

tokens.name: bg-grad-3
tokens.usage: `light` theme only: gradient end.

tokens.name: bg-blob-1
tokens.usage: `light` theme only: soft blob behind content (blur ≈120, 60%).

tokens.name: bg-blob-2
tokens.usage: `light` theme only: second soft blob (blur ≈120, 60%).

tokens.name: icon-ground
tokens.usage: App-icon artwork only (brown ground) — never a UI surface.

tokens.name: icon-thread
tokens.usage: Wordmark thread on the app icon's brown ground — icon artwork only.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The brand word. One joined word, no diacritics. Thread below it (see Wordmark).

styles.name: blessing-title
styles.usage: Title of a blessing (نعمة) on home, reflection and share cards.

styles.name: hadith
styles.sample: «أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ»

styles.name: scholar
styles.sample: نصّ اقتباس العالِم كما ورد في المحتوى.

styles.name: ayah
styles.usage: Quran text (Uthmani) only, always inside ﴿ ﴾, colour `ayah`. Never any other use.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary button label — never smaller (white on violet is large-text contrast only).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: نافذتك إلى الحياة، بها تبصر النور وتميز الوجوه.

styles.name: secondary
styles.usage: Secondary copy, compact buttons, empty states.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab-bar labels — shown on every screen.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Base step. Every spacing is a multiple of 4 except the measured 6/10/14/18/22 component paddings.

tokens.name: card-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: page-inset
tokens.usage: Horizontal page margin.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact).

tokens.name: card-pad-lg
tokens.usage: Card padding (roomy).

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target; compact button height.

tokens.name: button-h
tokens.usage: Primary button height.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Inputs, textareas, share-card inner card.

tokens.name: radius-dialog-button
tokens.usage: Buttons inside dialogs and empty states.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons, setting rows, quran block, top bar.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, tab bar.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Glass cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, toggles, toasts, avatar, dots.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Glass cards.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, tab bar.

tokens.name: blur-card
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur of `glass-card` (dark).

tokens.name: blur-raised
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur of `glass-raised`, and of all light-theme glass.

tokens.name: lattice-opacity
tokens.usage: Star lattice stroke (3–5%). Onboarding and reflection only.

tokens.name: cone-opacity
tokens.usage: Spotlight cone behind «نعمة اليوم» — maximum; dark theme only, optional.

tokens.name: scale-normal
tokens.usage: عادي — default user text size.

tokens.name: scale-large
tokens.usage: كبير — multiplies the whole type ramp; line-heights preserved.

tokens.name: scale-larger
tokens.usage: أكبر.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Lucide icons everywhere.

tokens.name: icon-size-tab
tokens.usage: Tab-bar icons.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Lucide strokeWidth.
